comparison.objective: Candidate sets a gripper opening stop; this record positions nickel strip and spot-welds it to four battery cells.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs bimanual screw/nut counterholding; the record aligns thin strip and sequentially seats two welding probes over four terminals.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks lock and angle retention through actuation; the record checks strip alignment, four weld contacts or pull-tested bonds, tool return, arm withdrawal, and pack integrity.
comparison.reason: Precision welding and bond formation do not exercise adjustable-stop preservation or countertorque.
